blocks.title: Dawn Raid
blocks.summary: Dawn Raid  Kess crouched on the rooftop of the old clocktower, a young scout with wind-tangled brown hair and a worn green scarf. Below, the harbor was already busy with iron ships.  "The signal flare goes up in one minute," whispered Brann
